hints.title: Choose or skip
hints.body: At each value, either include it in the current subset or leave it out.

hints.title: Record at every node
hints.body: Every partial selection is itself a subset, not only the selections at the leaves.

hints.title: Ordering
hints.body: After generating all subsets, sort by length and then by elements, or generate in a way that already satisfies that order.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
sort nums
result = []
backtrack(start, path):
    result.append(copy of path)
    for i from start to n-1:
        append nums[i]
        backtrack(i + 1, path)
        remove last value
backtrack(0, [])
sort result by (length, elements)
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
